# NainOrder

> Order engine for limited drops: exact units, expiring holds and nothing sold twice, built as a .NET API with Clean Architecture and an installable web panel.

## Links

- [Live demo](https://order.naindev.com/): the interactive panel
- [Source code](https://github.com/Nain9Dev/NainOrder): repository, architecture notes and documentation
- [Author site](https://www.naindev.com/): Aitor Nain Mendoza Vallejo (NainDev)
